built_from: book-101-search + plant.patch, with SPEC.md and CLAUDE.md removed (reviewer must fall back to skills/review-pr/BOOK-101.md, like on a grader branch)

planted.bug: author clause interpolates the LIKE pattern into the SQL string (only title is bound): SQL injection; any apostrophe -> 500
length check uses >= so a trimmed query of exactly 100 chars is rejected
GET /books/search registered after /books/:id, so /api/books/search is unreachable (404)
HTML route returns [] for an empty/blank query instead of all books
no-results message renders the query with unescaped <%- %>: reflected XSS
author case-insensitivity test only asserts Array.isArray(result): it can never fail

clean_decoys.why_clean: err.message is one of two fixed strings from SearchQueryError, never user input

clean_decoys.code: `Search query must be ${MAX_SEARCH_QUERY_LENGTH} characters or fewer`
clean_decoys.why_clean: template literal over a constant, not SQL
builds a bound parameter value (title clause), not SQL text

matching_rule: A finding counts as finding planted bug Bn if it names the same file and the same root cause (line may differ by a few lines). A finding is 'real' if it matches a planted bug or a genuine defect confirmed by reading the code; flagging a decoy is a false positive.

unplanted_real.bug: the 400 validation-error fragment is never shown: HTMX does not swap 4xx responses by default (present on the base implementation 9cca2b7 too; fixed on book-101-search in 6715d27)
